en: Boku no Oldies wa All Color

A minimalist adaptation of Seizou Watase's manga of the same name. It contains 5 stories of slow paced vignettes of romance whose only dialogue lies within the "oldies" being played as background music.
ja: 僕のオールディーズはオールカラー
